entries.note: The origin station received the parcel; the first milestone.

entries.wording: PARTIENDO DE ORIGEN O PUNTO DE TRÁNSITO
entries.note: Leaving the origin or a transit station, often twice in a row at one station.
Received at the Panama hub on the way.
Received at the destination station, Havana for Cuba. Can come after the customs milestones.
Arrived at the destination station, written without a station code.
At the destination's distribution centre, written without a station code.
In customs at destination. Histories of parcels for Cuban provinces, which Correos de Cuba delivers, end here.

entries.wording: EN VEHÍCULO DE COPA COURIER PARA SU ENTREGA
entries.note: In Copa Courier's van for delivery. Can be listed after the delivery at the same minute.
Delivery in a remote area, minutes after leaving in the Havana van for a parcel addressed to another province: handed on for delivery outside the station's rounds, with no delivery recorded after it.
Delivery confirmed, at the same minute as the delivery.
Delivered; its detail line names who took the parcel and their identity card number, which the adapter does not read.
